patronOf.en-US: Priest and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The seed is the word of God, Christ is the sower; all who come to him will live for ever.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A semente é a palavra de Deus e o semeador é Cristo: quem O encontrar permanecerá para sempre.

meta.face: A man of about forty-two with a broad-browed, strong face — a wide, high forehead, prominent, rounded cheekbones, a straight nose with a thick, rounded tip, large, dark, eager eyes under thick black brows, a wide mouth; short dark hair around a Capuchin tonsure, a very long, thick, dark-brown beard falling to the chest, and a fervent, commanding gaze lifted toward the crucifix.
meta.basis: His portraits show a Capuchin with a very long beard, bald in old age; the card shows him at forty-two, the age he was at the battle of Székesfehérvár (1601), so the beard is still dark. The raised crucifix is from the accounts of that battle.
